name: harness-core
description: The default tier of an AI coding-agent harness: one plugin to install, which brings the skills and the ledger's hooks with it. Each tag of this repository names one tested set.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: The plugin a person installs. It depends on the other plugins of this marketplace, so one install brings the set.

plugins.name: rails
plugins.description: Guard hooks for shell commands: deny destructive commands, ask before a push to main or a force-push. No hook in this plugin ever allows.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: The skills and agents of the harness, including the ticket skill.

plugins.name: ledger-hooks
plugins.description: The ledger's session brief and capture hooks. Pinned to one commit of the public ledger repository.
